deferred_UX.desired_behavior: Trusted-browser verification runs without showing the code form. Use a minimal Signing in indicator, then open the dashboard. Show the verification form only when user action is actually required.
deferred_UX.performance: Reduce perceived and measured sign-in delay; measure before choosing a specific timing target.
security_invariants: Do not open or fetch protected views before server proof succeeds
Retain actor/token binding, revocation and failure handling
Keep new-browser email-code checks and separate Admin MFA

new_browser_code_test.source_constraint: The gateway mailer matches the exact lowercased recipient against ZOHO_TEST_RECIPIENTS_JSON; an alias is not automatically included because its base Gmail address is allowed.

next_case.title: Invalid credentials

next_case.identity: Same owner-controlled test email that reached the dashboard
next_case.instructions: Use a signed-out private/browser context. Enter that email and a deliberately wrong password of at least eight characters, then click Sign in once. Return the displayed error and whether dashboard access remained denied. Keep all passwords private.

next_case.expected_access: Remain signed out; no dashboard or verification-code step
next_case.cleanup: Close the separate test context after reporting; do not clear the trusted original browser data.
